testcase.name: ledger thesis states map onto the design system's closed set()
assessment reports the invoker state honestly, including unconfigured()
trust tier maps to a status role, never a raw colour()
potential parses candidates with risk requirement and invalidation()
history parses closed trades with quadrant, attribution and lessons()
quadrant role never rewards a lucky bad decision as favourable()
events parses both headline and calendar-release rows plus impacts()
quadrant tally counts exactly the rows given, independent of a server total()
health never reads more favourable than the thesis, only as bad or worse()
positions parses the ledger's own shape, including a ledger-unavailable body()
significant events keeps only materiality at or above threshold()
